statement: A company's review date is the anniversary of its registration (unless a different date has effect under section 345C), and the directors must pass a solvency resolution within 2 months after each review date unless the company lodged a financial report with ASIC under Chapter 2M within the 12 months before it.
caveat: ASIC issues an annual statement at the review date and the annual review fee falls due under the Corporations (Review Fees) Act 2003; a negative solvency resolution, or a failure to resolve, must be notified to ASIC within 7 days under section 347B. Fee amounts change; check ASIC's current schedule.
